checks.note: facts.short_clips: all seven segments are narrated in en, es and zh-Hans, and the longest narration is 33.92 s (zh-Hans segment 6), under the 35 s ceiling. The chapter lists show the running times with the title card and pauses added: 0:12-0:28 in guide-en-desktop.png, 0:16-0:34 in guide-es-desktop.png, 0:15-0:36 in guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png. Nothing is a 2.5-minute block a patient has to sit through; each chapter stands on its own.

facts.no_owl: 18 files searched, no match. No owl or mascot appears in any screenshot. The four panels in guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png are the mastoid dressing on the head, the dressing being lifted off, the incision behind the ear, and a magnified view of the tape strips over the incision, with 'Check for tape' called out. That is the surgical site, drawn as Song asked.

facts.narrator: one voice per language (George for en, es and zh-Hans), all three narrated. No character appears or speaks in any screenshot; the page addresses the patient directly ('Two days after surgery, remove the mastoid dressing'). The same voice id is used for all three languages, which a screenshot cannot judge, so I am not judging how the Spanish and Mandarin read aloud.

facts.subtitles: captions for segments 1-7 in en, es and zh-Hans. At desktop width the caption band sits under the picture with the box checked by default (Captions in guide-en-desktop.png, Subtitulos in guide-es-desktop.png, the zi mu box in guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png), and the spoken word is highlighted in the band and in the transcript at the same time. At 375 px the transcript under the player is the caption track and carries the same highlight (guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png, guide-zh-Hans-phone.png); type is large and nothing is cut off at that width. One thing to tighten, not a failure: in guide-en-desktop.png the band's cue breaks mid-phrase after 'remove the mastoid', with 'dressing, or head bandage' in the next cue. It is a cue boundary, not a cut edge, since the Spanish band in guide-es-desktop.png breaks at the comma with the right half of the box empty, and the full sentence stands in the transcript beside it. Break the English cue after 'surgery,' instead.

facts.toc: 7 chapters listed, every jump landed exactly on its start (0, 12.4, 37.44, 61.92, 77.68, 101.28, 129.36 s) with the matching chapter marked active, and all seven visible at 1280x800 in each language. guide-en-desktop.png and guide-es-desktop.png show the numbered list with titles and durations down the left side; guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png shows the same in Mandarin. At phone width the chapter bar reads 'CHAPTER 1 OF 7' with back, forward and a dropdown (guide-en-phone.png), so a worried patient can reach 'When to call' without scrubbing.

facts.languages: both packs ok; the Spanish page title, first sentence and audio file are Spanish, the Mandarin ones Mandarin, and each audio file is in that language. The screenshots agree: guide-es-desktop.png is Spanish end to end (Idioma selector, chapter titles, transcript, Reproducir, Velocidad, Subtitulos, Imprimir la tarjeta, the phone labels in guide-es-phone.png), and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-phone.png are Mandarin end to end. No English left behind on the patient's side in either language.

facts.provider_file: paste to link took 18 ms, two steps (paste the block, copy the link), zero account or login fields, and no network requests after load, so nothing leaves the tab and there is no app to install. provider-filled.png shows the four fields Song asked for plus the reviewer row, each with its value control and a 'From' column reading 'your block', and 'Open this patient's guide' live in the corner. provider-draft.png shows the same table when the dot phrase still has its *** placeholders: it says in plain words which line it cannot read and asks the provider to choose, and offers the preset where there is one ('Use "about two weeks"' for follow-up). It does not guess a clinical yes or no, which is right. The link carries the choices (#a=0&p=1&f=2026-10-01&l=es) and guide-from-link.png opens in Spanish with 'Su revision de la herida y examen del oido: 1 de octubre de 2026' in the transcript. Noted for the clinic, not a failure of this check: with antibiotic No the guide simply says nothing about antibiotics, and the page says so and says it is waiting on your wording.

facts.review_line: one line in the block, 'Video guide: language {English/Spanish/Mandarin}    Reviewed by *** on ***' (visible at the bottom of the pasted note in provider-draft.png), no clinician badge, and review_date_in_link false, which matches the link fragment #a=0&p=1&f=2026-10-01&l=es. The page tells the truth about where it goes: provider-draft.png says 'Stays in your note. The patient's guide shows no reviewer line' and provider-filled.png says 'Not shown to the patient, and not carried in the link.' guide-from-link-badges.png, the transcript scrolled to the end of chapter 7, shows no reviewer line and no review date anywhere on the patient's page.

facts.card_summary: the card returns 200 and is on the first screen at both widths. 'Print the card' sits in the header at 1280x800 (guide-en-desktop.png, and translated in guide-es-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png), and at 375 px it is one tap away without scrolling, beside the speed control (guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png, guide-zh-Hans-phone.png).
